paragraphs.text: The strategically important river, the Mardun flowed from Ronom Lake and the Sardian Mountains , forming the border between the Great Desert and the Fallaji Empire on the western side, and the three kingdoms, Yotia , Argive , and Korlis on the eastern side. It emptied into the Shielded Sea just past Kroog .
After the later Ice Age and the Thaw , the river was inundated and swallowed by the Sea of Laments
